segments.text: Ten gifts for anyone who works from home, from twenty dollars, and the one catch to know before you buy each one.
Quick note: our links are affiliate links. It never changes our picks. Prices move daily, so always check the link.

segments.name: Large felt desk mat
segments.text: Number one. A large felt or leather desk mat, about twenty dollars. It covers the whole desk, quiets the keyboard, and makes the setup look finished. The catch? Measure the desk first. The popular ninety-centimeter mats hang over small desks.
segments.catch: Measure first. Big mats overhang small desks.

segments.name: Aluminum laptop stand
segments.text: Two. An aluminum laptop stand, about thirty dollars. It lifts the screen closer to eye level and folds flat for travel. Our top pick. The catch? Once the screen is up, they'll need a separate keyboard and mouse.
segments.catch: They'll also need a keyboard and mouse.

segments.name: Cable management kit
segments.text: Three. An under-desk cable management kit, about twenty dollars. Clips, sleeves and a tray hide the cable mess under the desk. The catch? It takes about half an hour to fit, so it suits someone who enjoys tidying.
segments.catch: About 30 minutes to fit. Best for tidiers.

segments.text: Still coming: a mug that keeps coffee hot through every meeting, and a mic that makes calls sound like radio.

segments.name: 3-in-1 wireless charger
segments.text: Four. A three-in-one wireless charging stand, about thirty-five dollars. Phone, earbuds and watch charge in one spot, so the desk stays clear of cables. The catch? Check that it supports their phone and watch brand first.
segments.catch: Check it fits their phone and watch brand.

segments.text: Fifty to a hundred and fifty dollars.
segments.label: $50 to $150

segments.name: Logitech MX Master 4
segments.text: Five. The Logitech MX Master four mouse, about a hundred and twenty dollars, and often under a hundred on sale. A fast scroll wheel, a thumb wheel, and it pairs with three computers. The catch? It's big and right-handed only. Small hands may prefer the MX Anywhere.

segments.name: Logitech MX Keys S
segments.text: Six. The Logitech MX Keys S keyboard, about a hundred and ten dollars. Quiet, backlit keys, and one button switches between three devices. The catch? It's full size, so it takes more desk space than a compact board.
segments.catch: Full size. Needs more desk space.

segments.name: BenQ ScreenBar light
segments.text: Seven. The BenQ ScreenBar monitor light, about a hundred and nine dollars. It sits on the monitor and lights the desk, with no glare on the screen. The catch? It needs a monitor. It won't sit on a laptop.
segments.catch: Needs a monitor, not a laptop.

segments.name: Ember Mug 2, 14 oz
segments.text: Eight. The Ember Mug two, from about ninety dollars depending on the color. It keeps coffee at the exact temperature they pick, through back-to-back meetings. The catch? The battery is short off the coaster, and it's hand-wash only.
segments.catch: Short battery off the coaster. Hand-wash only.

segments.label: Splurge
segments.sub: When it should feel like a present

segments.name: Kindle Colorsoft
segments.text: Nine. The Kindle Colorsoft, about two hundred and ninety dollars. A glare-free color screen, and a way to switch off from screens after work. The catch? Color is softer than a tablet. For plain novels, a regular Kindle costs less.
segments.catch: Softer color than a tablet. Novels only? Get a regular Kindle.

segments.name: Shure MV7+ microphone
segments.text: And ten. The Shure MV7 plus microphone, about two hundred and sixty-nine dollars. USB-C and XLR in one, so every call and recording sounds professional. The catch? It's a lot of mic for a few calls a week. For light use, a good headset is enough.
segments.catch: A lot of mic for light use. A headset may do.

segments.text: If you only buy one: the laptop stand they'll use every day, the MX Master as the best upgrade, or the Shure mic as the splurge.
Every pick is linked in the description and the pinned comment, with the full guide for the US and the UK. Happy gifting.
